_comment: Known-flaky tests under the full parallel suite (2000+ files). Each PASSES in true isolation (-t) — the flake is parallelism/resource contention, NOT a code defect. maxCount is a one-directional ratchet: lower it as flakes are structurally fixed (replay seam for external-server, test-isolation for timing). NEVER raise without a recorded reason. HISTORY: started at 4 (2 LSP external-server + 1 node-repl timing); the 2 LSP entries were RETIRED by SOTA ① (real rust-analyzer tests gated behind QUANTA_REAL_TOOLCHAIN_E2E serial lane + deterministic replay coverage in evidence-lsp-bridge-replay-deterministic.test.ts) — ratchet lowered 4 -> 2.

entries.name: a healthy exec still completes
entries.reason: intra-file interference: the sibling timeout-reap tests spawn/kill real node children, pressuring the real `node -i` REPL stdout flush so the best-effort content capture (line 95) loses the race. Passes with -t isolation (4/4). Fix path: per-test child isolation or make content check non-fatal (its own comment says ok:true+reusability is the deterministic proof).

entries.name: chaMultisiteSteer is injected into both the prompt prelude and localize-phase config
entries.reason: withEnv() mutates the process-GLOBAL QUANTA_BENCH_LOCALIZE_PHASE knob; under the full parallel suite a sibling bench test reading/writing the same env var races the set->assert->restore window (the code-under-test reads process.env at call time). Passes with -t isolation (4/4, verified 3x). Fix path: thread localize-phase as an explicit param into the closure-prompt-wiring builder (drop the process.env read) so the test needs no global mutation — then retire this entry and lower maxCount.
